[
  {"step":1,"file":"fuzzer/fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":797,"var":"data/size","code":"EXTRACT_IF(&randseed, data, size, sizeof(randseed));","note":"The raw fuzzer input begins as attacker-controlled bytes and the first 4 bytes are consumed as the PRNG seed that drives later policy extraction."},
  {"step":2,"file":"fuzzer/fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":801,"var":"policy_chain","code":"policy_chain = extract_policies(&data, &size);","note":"The remaining input is parsed into the initial SRTP policy chain that will be used to create the session context."},
  {"step":3,"file":"fuzzer/fuzzer.c","function":"extract_policies","line":null,"var":"policy->key / policy->keys / policy->num_master_keys","code":"Policy fields are decoded from the input stream into srtp_policy_t nodes.","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes determine the master-key pointers, optional MKI data, and the number of master keys for each stream policy."},
  {"step":4,"file":"srtp/srtp.c","function":"srtp_create","line":null,"var":"policy_chain","code":"srtp_create(&srtp_ctx, policy_chain)","note":"The parsed policy chain is converted into a live SRTP session, which later calls srtp_add_stream for each policy node."},
  {"step":5,"file":"srtp/srtp.c","function":"srtp_add_stream","line":2855,"var":"policy","code":"status = srtp_stream_init(tmp, policy);","note":"Each policy is allocated into a stream object and handed to stream initialization, carrying the attacker-selected master-key configuration forward."},
  {"step":6,"file":"srtp/srtp.c","function":"srtp_stream_init","line":1309,"var":"p->key / p->keys / p->num_master_keys","code":"err = srtp_stream_init_all_master_keys(srtp, p->key, p->keys, p->num_master_keys);","note":"Stream initialization forwards the policy's master-key list into the key setup routine without changing the attacker-controlled count."},
  {"step":7,"file":"srtp/srtp.c","function":"srtp_stream_init_all_master_keys","line":867,"var":"keys[i]","code":"status = srtp_stream_init_keys(srtp, keys[i], i);","note":"The loop indexes directly into the policy-provided master-key array and passes each entry to key initialization."},
  {"step":8,"file":"srtp/srtp.c","function":"srtp_stream_init_keys","line":900,"var":"session_keys = &srtp->session_keys[current_mki_index]","code":"session_keys = &srtp->session_keys[current_mki_index];","note":"The current master-key index selects a session_keys slot that is later dereferenced for cipher and auth setup."},
  {"step":9,"file":"srtp/srtp.c","function":"srtp_stream_init_keys","line":923,"var":"session_keys->rtp_cipher / session_keys->rtcp_cipher","code":"input_keylen = full_key_length(session_keys->rtp_cipher->type);","note":"The code dereferences cipher pointers from the selected session_keys slot; if the slot was not fully initialized for the attacker-chosen master-key layout, this becomes an out-of-bounds read."}
]
